target_coefficients.M1: first epsilon derivative at epsilon=0 of every normalized memory Euler-Lagrange source block
target_coefficients.M2: second epsilon derivative at epsilon=0 along the same first-order direction

deterministic_audit.first_order_direction: fixed multi-harmonic deterministic perturbations in N,L,R,b,r,phi,q

reports_no_gate: relative size of direct metric M2 blocks
M2 source geometry on deterministic audit fields
claim_boundary: PASS certifies the explicit action-derived NL0B memory source coefficients M1 and M2 needed by the NL1B2 H4 hierarchy. It does not generate the memory-off analytic Q block, solve Z20/Z21, introduce finite eta, or make collapse/observational claims.
anti_tuning: Do not change the action, expansion point, audit fields, grid sizes, finite-difference steps, source list or thresholds after inspecting GE05 output.
